objective: Proof and exhaustive finite check. For a Fano atom with its other elements present, show that creation at each of its lines from any removal beyond one of its cuts depends only on the relation that the removal's side shows on that cut's three ports, by feeding every deeper relation compatible with each port relation at once; tabulate the verdict for every port relation. Test on the census that, in real spaces, the removal's side acts only through that relation.
status: Proved: creation at a closed Fano atom from any removal beyond a cut depends only on the relation the removal's side shows on the cut's ports (emitter: receives iff the ports may be equal; receiver: a cut line iff the other two ports are not forced equal, an intact line iff the side tells the ports apart); 8,190 of 8,190 cases; computed on the census, 47,550 of 47,550 pairs
title: Creation is decided by the receiving cut
